description: This file defines the MyLeaveListController class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It extends LeaveListController and overrides the preRender method to prepare a Vue component for rendering a user's leave list, adding various properties related to leave statuses, types, and date ranges.

classes.name: MyLeaveListController
classes.description: A controller class for handling the 'My Leave List' view, extending the base LeaveListController and customizing the preRender method for specific leave view functionality.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with leave-related properties before rendering the view.
